findings.capability: T2 plus PYTHONPATH=<repo> in the environment
findings.title: Companion subprocesses inherit PYTHONPATH, so a repo-root module shadows the standard library inside them
findings.summary: The preflight exports PYTHONSAFEPATH=1 to its children, which suppresses the script-directory/cwd prepend but not PYTHONPATH. With PYTHONPATH=<repo root> (the form the repository's own tests/unit/governance/test_evol_x_real_repo_fresh_clone.py::_env sets) an untracked, ignored root json.py runs inside verify_iiac_audit_manifest.py and verify_iiac_role_separation.py. Without PYTHONPATH the companions are safe.
findings.reproduction: raw5/r4_root_modules.txt: marker lines from both companions for 'root json.py, PYTHONPATH=<clone>' and 'python -m + PYTHONPATH'; none without PYTHONPATH. The preflight process itself never ran the planted module.
findings.impact: Only the companions' exit codes can be influenced; after P2 their inputs (manifest, schema, audited/execution SHAs) are sealed, so no reachable false PASS is shown. Defence-in-depth gap.
findings.required_correction: Drop PYTHONPATH (and PYTHONHOME/PYTHONSTARTUP) from the children's environment, or run them with -I.

findings.title: Any untracked python file or package at the repository root blocks both gates
findings.summary: The new check flags every untracked *.py/*.pyc/*.pyd at the root and every untracked directory with __init__.py (even my_scratch.py, tmp_pkg/), although the root is already stripped from sys.path. Other untracked root files (notes.txt, scratch.md) and files under scripts/dev, tests/ and docs are accepted.
findings.impact: Fail-closed usability cost; run from a clean root.
findings.required_correction: Acceptable as is; optionally restrict to names that exist in the standard library.

findings.capability: T4 (and T2 when the venv is inside the checkout)
findings.title: Interpreter-level hooks force PASS; the project venv is a git-ignored directory inside the checkout
findings.summary: A .pth file (importing a module that prints PASS and exits 0) in the interpreter's site-packages made the canonical clone return PASS, exit 0, git status clean. sitecustomize on PYTHONPATH did the same in round 4. The repository's .venv (git-ignored) lives inside the working tree, so for `uv run` users this is also a write-to-ignored-files case. Not closable inside the script; running on a fresh clone with a clean interpreter is the only mitigation. Untested: usercustomize, PYTHONSTARTUP (interactive only), brute-forcing the predictable pycache prefix (temp dir/evolx-preflight-no-bytecode-cache/<pid>).
findings.required_correction: Operator decision OD-2; certifier runs from a fresh clone with a clean interpreter.
